## Recent work: a short narrative of what was done recently and what is still relevant.

Webhook delivery now supports bounded retries: `max_attempts` defaults to 3, transport errors are retried, server errors are retried, and client errors remain immediate failures. The final transport exception is re-raised. Added tests for transport retry, exhaustion, server retries, and non-retryable 4xx behavior; `pytest -q tests/test_webhooks.py` passed 8 tests. The full suite passed 44 tests. Ruff and `git diff --check` are clean.

The separate onboarding procedure has completed validation and organization creation; the remaining steps are database migration, seed, billing customer, welcome email, setup-fee invoice, and final status confirmation.

The active coding goal is still GET `/v1/invoices` pagination in `ledgerly/api/invoices.py`. Search indexing investigation found two existing failures involving recently updated invoice descriptions and a likely per-page/per-document embedding latency bottleneck.
